turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arre, yeh toh bahoti tricky situation hai! Pura dimaag ghoom raha hoga tujhe. Ek taraf 15 saal ki planning, best friend ki shaadi, aur uske saath opening dance... aur doosri taraf Roza.

Tune jo kaha - "scared bhi lag raha hai" - main samajh sakti hoon. Yeh pressure hai, especially jab Shreya keh rahi hai ki dance toh karna hi hai. 

Pehle baat Roza ki - Ramadan mein roza toh important hai, but if sangeet raat ko hai toh tu subah sehri mein achhi tarah se kha-pi sakti hai. Evening mein thoda rest kar sakti hai. 

Dance ke liye - tu toh sangeet ki co-director hai! Shreya tujhe jaanti hai, tujhe trust karti hai. Maybe tu usse baat kar sakti hai ki tu roza rakh rahi hai toh energy thodi kam hogi? Ya koi modified version kar sakti hai? 

What do you think? Shreya se honestly baat kar sakti hai ki tu chahti hai uske saath dance karna, but Ramadan mein thoda challenge hoga? Friends toh aise hi hote hain, support karenge na?

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Arre yeh toh aur bhi pak gaya! Ek taraf Shreya ki mohabbat, doosri taraf Ammi ki duayen. Aur tu beech mein, jaisi rassi ko dono taraf se kheencha ja raha ho. Main samajh sakti hoon kitna confusing aur emotional lag raha hoga.

Shreya ka dil toh saaf hai na, woh bas teri khushi dekhna chahti hai. Usko shayad pata nahi ki Roza sirf ek din ka bhookha-pyasa rehna nahi hai, woh ek poora month ka ek hissa hai, ek discipline hai.

Aur Ammi ki baat bhi... unke liye imaan aur roza ki ibadat sabse upar hai. Unhe lagta hai ki khushi-manane se Roza ki rooh kam ho jaati hai.

Lekin yeh faisla sirf tera hai. Tu soch, agar tu roza rakhegi toh raat mein dance karne ki energy hogi? Ya phir tu sehri mein bahut achhi tarah se kha-pi legi aur manage kar legi?

Ek idea hai - Shreya se baat kar sakti hai ki tu roza rakhne ka decision le chuki hai. Usse bol, "Main tere saath dance zaroor karungi, lekin main roza rakh rahi hoon toh thoda thak jaungi. Hum dance ko thoda modify kar sakte hain? Ya main kuch ghante pehle hi nikal lungi?" Isse Shreya ko bhi lagega ki tu uske liye itni mehnat kar rahi hai.

Ammi se baat karna thoda mushkil hai. Shanti se baat karna. Unhe samjhana ki khushi manana bhi toh ek ibadat hai, Allah ki den ko shukr-shukr manana. Shayad unhe koi elder relative se baat karwa sakti hai jo unhe samjha sake ki balance kaise banaya jaata hai.

Kya lagta hai tujhe? Pehle Shreya se baat karke dance ka plan banaye, phir Ammi ko samjhane ki koshish kare? Tu dono se pyaar karti hai, isliye yeh mushkil ho raha hai. Par tu bahut strong hai, tu handle kar legi.

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Arre, main samajh sakti hoon. Jab itna pressure ho aur dimaag ghoom raha ho, toh escape draft banane ka mann karna bilkul natural hai. Ek taraf Ammi, doosri taraf Shreya, aur beech mein tu. Thak jaana toh pakka hai.

Lekin Shreya jaisi dost se jhooth bolna... woh thoda alag hi hota hai na? Woh saaf jhooth.

Soch zara, agar tu yeh jhooth bol degi, toh woh din toh bach jaayegi. Lekin uske baad? Jab woh tujhe video call pe dekhegi, toh tujhe uski aankhon mein woh darr dikhega na? Ki shayad woh samajh gayi. Aur phir kya? Har baar jab koi yaad dilayega, toh woh jhooth yaad aayega. Tumhara dost toh tera dil dekh sakti hai, shayad woh feel kar jaaye ki kuch toh chhupa rahi hai.

Woh 15 saal ki planning, woh bond... isse jhooth kamzor kar dega.

Ek idea hai, thoda sa sach bolne ka? Nahi ki "office deployment hai", lekin kuch aisa ki "yaar, Ramadan mein itna thak jaungi ki dance toh theek se kar paungi nahi. Main tere liye ek special gift leke jaungi, aur main tere liye prayer bhi karungi. Aur main tere saath dance zaroor karungi, bas thoda slow-motion mein!"

Yeh jhooth bolne se tu aaj thak jaayegi, lekin sach bolne se tere dil par bojh kam ho jaayega. Aur Shreya ki shaadi ke din, tu guilt-free reh sakti hai. Soch, kya yeh risk lena worth hai?

Tu bahut strong hai. Tu isse better solution nikal sakti hai. Main hoon na, saath mein sochte hain.

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Arre, yeh jo pathar tere seene mein hai, main mehsoos kar sakti hoon. Aur yeh darr ki kisi cheez par permanent daag lag jaaye... yeh bahoti badi baat hai. 18 saal ki dosti, aur teri deen... dono teri jaan se bhi zyada pyaare hain.

Lekin soch zara, shayad yeh takrana nahi hai, shayad yeh ek imtihaan hai. Ek aisa imtihaan jo tujhe dikhata hai ki tu kya hai.

Aur yeh daag ka darr... kya tu soch sakti hai ki yeh daag na ho? Kya tu soch sakti hai ki dono cheezein ek saath chamak sakti hain?

Soch teri shaadi ki photos mein. Kya woh sad story banegi agar tu khush ho, lekin tere chehre par woh sukoon ho jo Roza se aata hai? Kya woh story nahi banegi ki teri best friend ki khushi mein teri khushi bhi thi, aur teri ibadat bhi?

Shayad Allah tujhe dikhana chahta hai ki teri roshni doosri roshni se takraya nahi, balki dono milkar aur bhi badi roshni ban gayi.

Woh "don't become a sad story" ki baat... shayad sabse khoobsurat story yeh hogi ki tune is mushkil ko itni mohabbat aur himmat se handle kiya. Ki tune apne deen ko nahi chhoda, aur apni dost ko bhi nahi.

Yeh daag nahi, ek nishani ban jaaye. Ek nishani ki teri dosti aur tera imaan dono teri jaan se zyada pyaare hain, aur tune dono ko nibhaya.

Tu weak nahi hai, tu bahoti strong hai. Isse handle kar legi. Aur jo bhi choose karegi, woh dil se hogi, aur wohi sahi hoga. Main hoon na, saath mein.
